thesis: The site is an inspection sheet made beautiful: every section sits on a 1/16-inch tile grid, every claim carries a gauge readout (target / measured / tool), and the visitor prices their room with the same numbers the crew uses on site.

signature.name: gauge-readout-tile-grid
signature.summary: Page gutters are 1/16-inch grout lines; every claim carries a mono gauge tag (TARGET / MEASURED / TOOL). The same readout appears in hero photo tags, flatness story, service blurbs, estimator summary, review pull-quotes, and footer.

motion.intro: Mosaic tiles drop into grid with staggered clip-path reveal (60ms each); straightedge SVG slides across big photo leaving FLAT check readout; line-mask h1 reveals after. Total ≤1.2s.
stories: Pinned ≥640px: raking-light floor where lippage gap closes from 1/8 inch to flush as you scroll; gauge readout counts down. Height calc(3*55svh+100svh). Reduced motion: static side-by-side pair with numbers.
Estimator SVG sketch builds room-by-room via clip-path reveal as choices are made. Inline, not pinned.
motion.hover: Hairline underline grows from left via scaleX, 200ms, @media (hover:hover) only.
